_doc: Nhoa's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/vowbound/nhoa.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/nhoa/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. She is bound light (color_script.md rule 2): every emissive slot is glimmer_bound #4FB3B0 at energy 1.2 with no pulse (steady: no flicker, no drift, no shed motes), and the vertex emission mask sets each part's share. body is the dark inner body the light is held in (abyss_navy, not lit). motes is the swarm of skinned beads (salt_glass, a mask of 0.4 to 1.0 per bead, so the swarm has depth). antler is the two crowns of mangrove root (timber_weathered paling to bone at the tips, a mask of 0.25 along the tips only). eye is soft and glowing (deep_teal_shadow, mask 0.55). shell is the keepsake, the carved name-shell (bone with tattoo_ink carving) and its sand_cloth cord: an object, never lit. Nothing on her is frozen (ADR 0015): the cold is the light's colour against the dark. Colours are palette.json swatches.
